item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Chilly again tonight with Cold Weather Advisory for inland hills, valleys
item.description: It's going to get chilly again tonight. A Cold Weather Advisory goes up for the inland valleys, hills and mountains from 1 a.m. to 9 a.m. tomorrow. Overnight, high clouds will spread across our region and they will filter the sunshine tomorrow afternoon.

item.title: Judge says Trump administration can't block child care, other program money for 5 states for now
item.description: A federal judge ruled Friday that President Donald Trump's administration cannot block federal money for child care subsidies and other programs.

item.title: SF's Sunset District business owners meet with PG&E after weeks of blackouts
item.description: The three businesses visited during the merchant walk were impacted by the blackout in San Francisco on December 20, and are making claims beyond the PG&E automatic credits.

item.title: Walnut Creek water main break snarls traffic with 2nd day of repair work
item.description: Traffic has been backed up along a stretch of Ygnacio Valley Road in Walnut Creek since Thursday as crews continue to work on repairing a water main break, which isn't expected to be finished until Saturday morning.

item.title: 'General Hospital' legend Jane Elliot celebrates Tracy Quartermaine, 60 years in television
item.description: In the world of daytime dramas, actress Jane Elliot is a legend. She's appeared on nine soap operas over 60 years, but is best known for her Emmy-winning role on "General Hospital."

item.title: Newsom faces another multibillion-dollar budget shortfall in his last year as governor
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom's office said the state faces a $2.9 billion budget deficit this year, an amount significantly lower than what legislative budget analysts projected.

item.title: Bay Area doctor shoots down 'baseless' claim that 49ers injuries are caused by EMF from substation
item.description: "What a wild headline and claim." It has been another 49ers season plagued by the injury bug, and there's a wild theory circulating on social media that attempts to explain why. We asked a Bay Area doctor about the plausibility.

item.title: Remembering John Beam: Celebration of life to be held for legendary Oakland coach Saturday
item.description: A celebration of life will be held on Saturday for legendary Oakland coach John Beam, who tragically died in November. His celebration can be watched here on ABC7.

item.title: Newly obtained cellphone video shows moments before deadly ICE shooting of Renee Good in Minneapolis
item.description: Good is seen reversing the car and then turning the steering wheel right, as someone can be heard yelling out, "Drive!"

item.title: Bay Area cities ramp up efforts to fight human trafficking ahead of Super Bowl LX
item.description: "San Francisco will not look the other way. Instead, we will coordinate across law enforcement, social services, and community partners, not in silos - not after the fact, but in real-time," said San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie.
